verdict.rationale: Gusto's official CLI ships a `gusto timesheet` command and a bundled timesheet-sync skill that drives the per-cycle timesheet input flow, plus a payroll-prep skill that maps per-cycle inputs onto a draft payroll; Gusto also says it partners with time-tracking apps. Payroll runs are pre-generated from pay schedules, so timesheet data has a regular run to land in. However, nothing shows overtime being calculated or carried through, the CLI only drafts payroll and cannot submit it, and there is no API doc for hours/time entries feeding a regular payroll. Missing for 10: explicit overtime handling, first-party API docs for hourly time entries flowing into regular payroll, end-to-end (non-draft) flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
